mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONTENT_MASTER (CONTENT_ID, USER_ID, CONTENT_TYPE) VALUES (#{contentId}, #{userId}, #{contentType})
mapper.select: SELECT CONTENT_ID, USER_ID, CONTENT_TYPE, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CREATED_AT) * 1000 AS CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(UPDATED_AT) * 1000 AS UPDATED_AT FROM CONTENT_MASTER WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT_MASTER SET UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE CONTENT_ID = #{contentId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
